name: name
description: Extracts the model story's headline — the one line a business user would recognize

name: description
description: Extracts a short summary of what the model decides

name: displayMarkdown
description: Renders the whole story as markdown: what it decides, what the data says, why it matters, each component's contribution and reuse note, and the caveats

name: trustGrade
description: The deterministic trust grade the story was written against (Poor/Fair/Good/Excellent)

name: componentCount
description: How many components the story describes

name: reusableComponentCount
description: How many of the components are marked high reuse potential — what makes this story worth searching
